newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PRESS DIGEST - South Africa - April 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - South Africa - April 28.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the South African on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Zaire rebel leader Laurent Kabila and President Mobutu Sese Seko have "agreed in principle" on a venue for face-to-face peace talks early next week, a source said.

- The provincial education department in South Africa's populous Gauteng province around Johannesburg overspent by more than one billion rand last year, causing it to be underfunded by more than 500 million rand this year.
- Winnie Madikizela-Mandela was re-elected African National Congress Women's League president at the weekend and pledged to uphold the truth and lead women to full freedom.
